newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kintetsu World sets up freight forwarder in India.
newsitem.headline: Kintetsu World sets up freight forwarder in India.

text.p: Japan's second-largest transport company, Kintetsu World Express Inc, said on Wednesday it has set up the first Japanese freight forwarder in southern India's booming Bangalore district.
Kintetsu World is a unit of Kinki Nippon Railway Co Ltd

The Indian subsidiary, Kintetsu World Express (India) Pvt Ltd, is wholly owned by Kintetsu World's Singapore-based investment unit, Kintetsu South Asia Development Pte Ltd, and is capitalised at 17.5 million yen, Kintetsu World said in a statement.
The company, which is expected to begin operations on August 15, will offer air and surface freight forwarding, customs clearing, and storage and cargo transport services, it said.
Business opportunities are increasing in Bangalore because the region's "silicon valley" economy is booming, Kintetsu World said.
Kintetsu World also plans to open offices in Bombay and New Delhi soon, it said.
